title: get plans endpoint
description: Verify that the GET /api/v1/plans endpoint returns a list of billing plans with correct data structure and enforces API key authentication and rate limiting.

title: post plans endpoint
description: Test the POST /api/v1/plans endpoint to create a new billing plan, ensuring validation of input data, authentication, and proper response with the created plan details.

title: get individual plan endpoint
description: Validate the GET /api/v1/plans/:id endpoint to retrieve details of a specific billing plan by ID, including handling of non-existent IDs and authentication enforcement.

title: put individual plan endpoint
description: Test the PUT /api/v1/plans/:id endpoint for updating an existing billing plan, verifying input validation, authentication, and correct update of plan data.

title: delete individual plan endpoint
description: Verify the DELETE /api/v1/plans/:id endpoint to remove a billing plan, ensuring proper authentication, handling of non-existent IDs, and confirmation of deletion.

title: get invoices endpoint
description: Test the GET /api/v1/invoices endpoint to list invoices with correct pagination, filtering, authentication, and response structure.

title: post invoices endpoint
description: Validate the POST /api/v1/invoices endpoint to create a new invoice, checking input validation, authentication, and response with invoice details.

title: post invoice pay endpoint
description: Verify the POST /api/v1/invoices/:id/pay endpoint to mark an invoice as paid, ensuring authentication, correct status update, and error handling for invalid invoice IDs.

title: post invoice cancel endpoint
description: Test the POST /api/v1/invoices/:id/cancel endpoint to cancel an invoice, verifying authentication, status update, and handling of invalid or already paid invoices.

title: post webhooks endpoint
description: Validate the POST /api/v1/webhooks endpoint to receive webhook events, including signature verification, event processing, and triggering Discord role assignments and notifications.
